The structure of Dy4Ni4Pd4 (reduced formula DyNiPd) crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Ni, 6 Pd) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ni and Pd centers each have 12 neighbors (6 Dy, 6 of the other transition metal) at 2.8238 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Dy 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Ni and Pd 12-vertex polyhedra.
